snippet.title: A Game About Forgetting How to MOVE?? | Discontrolled Devlog 1
snippet.description:
What's going on, guys! 🚀 This week, we're back with the first episode for our devlog series - covering our new game DISCONTROLLED for Playdate!

Discontrolled - The Game:
- 🏆 Playdate Community Awards 2024 Trailer - https://youtu.be/gq6Eay27iA8
- 🕹️ Jam Version - Play it Now! https://franchovy.itch.io/discontrolled
- 👾 Want to become a playtester? Sign up here: https://docs.google.com/forms/d/e/1FAIpQLScbYBIaEsHzWvH9pSobPsvTzbgQtM98EG8yeSKuQqBcA7zOwg/viewform

🖌️ Special thanks to our artists:
- Drillbot - Jam Version: Vachi 🥚 
- Dan Mafra - Pixel Artist 🖼️ https://www.behance.net/DANIELMMAFRA

 🟪 🟦 SPILASKOPA 🟦 🟨

🔥 Buh: https://verynameboi.itch.io/ 💡
